summary: st alerts replaces st attention in the CLI (the old name stays as an alias); st now leads with N alerts, says nothing when none wait, and lists unread updates apart without counting them

replay.detail: No replay, backfill or stored data change.

schema.detail: No database or client schema change.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: st attention and all its subcommands keep working as an alias of st alerts. Human output changes: st now prints 'N alerts' (nothing when there are none) and an UPDATES section instead of NEEDS YOU; st alerts ls prints ALERTS FOR PERSON then UPDATES. JSON output is unchanged. Gate cards now suggest st alerts approve|reject; an older st binary given that argv fails to parse it, so install the same build everywhere.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

manual.detail: No manual action is required. Scripts that grep st now for NEEDS YOU should read --json instead.

recovery.detail: Swap back freely; nothing is stored.
